source.text: 有獸，左右有首，名曰屏蓬。

inferred.item: 四足猫科兽形与一条中短尾
inferred.basis: 原文只称兽，未指定物种、足数、尾数或尾长；猫科躯干、四足足掌、耳鼻形态和单尾均为设计补足，不将猪形并入 source。

inferred.item: 同一宽肩向左右分出短颈，各接一首
inferred.basis: 据「左右有首」明确画出横向并列的两首；具体双颈、同一肩带的连接结构、头颈大小及位置均为构型解释，不作前后双首。
经文未记两首的具体朝向、视线或转动范围；左右对称向外张望的角度是为了辨认左右双首而作的设计选择。

inferred.item: 赭褐斑毛、米白颌胸与琥珀双眸
inferred.basis: 本条没有猪形、黑色或其他色彩记录；全部毛色、斑纹、鼻爪色及两首相同的琥珀眼色均为艺术设色。

inferred.item: 四足稳步、双首侧望与交替低吟
inferred.basis: 正文未记习性、动作或鸣声；四拍缓步、微呼吸、双首侧望、尾部回摆及合成低吟均为交互演绎，不补写争执不能前进等后世说法。

sourceVerification.contextBefore: 大荒之中，有山，名曰鏖鏊鉅，日月所入者。
sourceVerification.contextAfter: 有巫山者。有壑山者。有金門之山，有人名曰黄姖之尸。
sourceVerification.note: 本条独立为有獸，左右有首，名曰屏蓬。相邻山名并未明确写屏蓬居于该山，故不拼接引文或推演栖地；没有猪形、黑色、前后双首，也不与并封混为一兽。

bodyAndHeads.note: Returned filename is base_basic_pbr.glb; Extreme-High identity independently checked in credits.log plus hashes and mesh counts. Both lateral heads are duplicated crops from this verified master, not separately generated HIGH jobs.

production.adaptation: Source forehead horn flattened and painted into coat; original central head/upper neck removed. Two 7,612-triangle HIGH crops rotated laterally with positive scales, through an original authored smoothly unioned bifurcating shoulder. Only new shoulder geometry is voxel-unioned, never the dense HIGH body/head/tail surfaces. Source UV/fur retained and recoloured. Authored shoulder fur is original texture work, not claimed AI HIGH generation. One HIGH tail curved and shortened offline. Guarded inverse-transpose numerical Jacobians transform source normals without computeVertexNormals. Own 35-bone rig with two independent neck/head chains and thirteen tail bones.

parentAudit.resources: Cached scene ink materials and outlines installed in an effect; cleanup removes outlines, restores original materials, and disposes owned materials.
parentAudit.method: Real useFrame advance at 60 Hz: 432 walk frames, 252 idle/special frames; three noncollinear CPU-skinned sole vertices per paw, world XYZ displacement, yaw and triangle normal. Refresh scene matrixWorld and skeleton before each sample.
parentAudit.checks: Three remounts preserve 48 nodes, five surfaces, five outlines, one root and two lateral heads; no nonfinite data or browser errors. Actual narration 70.269375s advances in running AudioContext without media error; cry invoked; special returns to idle. Concept four views and final three poses plus six motion closeups inspected.

production.animationEncoding: 120 Hz LINEAR samples preserve exact quarter-cycle paw landings. gltf-transform optimize uses --simplify false --flatten false --join false --instance false --palette false --resample false --texture-compress webp --texture-size 2048 --compress meshopt; animation resampling must remain disabled to preserve planted support.
